zombie.name: zombie process
man: Died, but was never reaped. Still holds its rifle and its PID.
Hitscan: when it takes aim (red !) its next shot cannot be dodged.
Kill it first, or put a wall between you. It misses more at range.

sudo.name: sudo zombie
sudo.death: %s is reaped. Its privileges go with it.
man: A zombie that once had sudo. It still believes it does.
Three pellets at once; deadly up close, poor at a distance.
Keep your distance, or get to it before it takes aim.

orphan.name: orphan
man: Lost its parent process. Found something else instead.
Raises a burning hand (orange !), then throws fire at where you stand.
The fire flies a cell a beat: step out of its way.
It burns whatever it meets first - and that one will not forgive.

daemon.name: daemon
man: Ran in the background until it smelt you.
Melee charger: a cell a beat, then teeth.
Shotgun it up close, or back off and let something else hit it.

spawner.name: spawner
spawner.death: %s bursts. Its children are orphans now.
man: fork(), fork(), fork(). It never waits for its children.
Every few beats it spawns a lost+found soul, up to three at a time.
Kill it first; the souls are only its noise.

soul.name: lost+found soul
man: Fragments nobody claimed, burning with resentment.
Flies two cells a beat and bites. Ten health: one good hit.

barrel.name: barrel
man: Pressurised coolant, gone bad.
Bursts for 40 at everything next to it - you too, within one cell.

cron.name: Cron

attack.wake_text: Cron opens its eye. Its hands begin to turn. crontab -l:

enraged.text: Cron rewrites its crontab: */2. It is in a hurry now.

text: Cron's hands spin backwards. Its face cracks.
crond: job rescheduled for the end of time.

man: CRON(8) - the daemon that keeps time. It was here before root, and it means to outlast it.
It does not chase. It schedules: every few beats fire falls on a pattern of
the floor - marked a beat ahead. Read the crontab, step off the marked floor.
It forks lost+found souls to keep you busy. Hurt it enough and it rewrites
its own schedule. Nobody has ever seen it die.

kworker.name: kworker
man: A kernel worker with its cables out and a pistol in hand. Always busy.
Dodges: it may sidestep a shot it sees coming, at two cells or more.
Up close it cannot - and a shotgun's spread finds it anyway.

kswapd.name: kswapd
man: Swaps you out of memory with a drum of slugs. Slow: it moves every other beat.
Three shots a burst. When it takes aim (red !), break the line or close in.

shred.name: shred
man: Overwrites what it finds, then burns the copy.
Sprays fire three cells along a row or a column - only when you are in line.
When it levels its nozzle (orange !), step out of the line. The fire stays a few beats.
Its tanks burst when it dies. Do not stand beside it, or on oil.

crawler.name: crawler
man: Indexes everything it can reach, three red eyes first.
Fast: two cells a beat. Weak: one shotgun blast up close ends it.

spinlock.name: spinlock
man: Holds the lock and will not let go.
Spins up for two beats (red !!), then fires every beat while it sees you.
Break its line of sight - a wall, a crate - and the barrels wind down.

loader.name: cargo loader

vehicle.board: You strap into the loader's cage. Space: claw. Walk into them: tread. Enter: climb down.
vehicle.leave: You unstrap and drop down out of the cage. The loader stands where you left it.
vehicle.wreck: The loader's hydraulics burst. You tumble out of the cage as it goes up.

man: LD(8) - the facility's cargo loader. It links what arrives to where it is needed.
Walk into it to climb in. It wades through acid, treads on what is in its way,
shoves containers you cannot move, and takes the hits instead of you - 150 of them.
It will not go through doors. Enter climbs down. When it gives out, it blows up.

scout.name: scout drone
man: A refitted survey drone: two thrusters, one red eye, one small gun.
Floats over acid and belts. Sidesteps a shot it sees coming, like a kworker.

hornet.name: hornet drone
hornet.death: %s pops in a puff of sparks.
man: Two rotors and a cutting nose. They come in swarms, two cells a beat.
Twelve health: anything kills one. Never all of them at once.

warden.name: warden drone
warden.death: %s comes down like a dropped anvil.
man: The assembly floor's warden: armour plate, two plasma guns, no patience.
Slow: it moves every other beat. Its bolts fly a cell a beat - step aside.
Rockets are what it respects.

xantrium.name: Xantrium ball
man: Recycled Xantrium, pressed into a ball: what drone and battle robot hulls are made of.
Walk into one and it rolls - two cells a beat, eight cells on, crushing what it meets.
It knocks another ball on, breaks a hollow wall, holds a plate down, and sinks in acid
to make a step. Shots ping off it; a blast next to it sets it rolling.

xantrium_core.name: Xantrium core
man: A whole charge of Xantrium, before the press. As tall as a door.
Once it rolls, it rolls a cell a beat until a wall stops it. Do not stop in front of it.

hopper.name: Swamp Hopper

vehicle.board: You drop into the X-47B's seat and pull the canopy shut. Space: the twin cannon. It flies over acid and swamp - while the fuel lasts.
vehicle.start: The fans spool up and the hopper lifts off the pad.
vehicle.leave: You pop the canopy and climb down.
vehicle.empty: The fuel gauge hits zero. The fans cough, slow, and stop; the hopper settles on the swamp.
vehicle.wreck: The hopper's fan pods tear loose. You are thrown out as it goes up.

man: X-47B Swamp Hopper: an armoured hovering scout of the Eryxian fleet, twin ducted fans.
Walk into it to climb in. It needs fuel - cans pour in when you board or pick them up -
and burns a beat of it every beat once it has lifted off. Space fires the twin cannon.
It flies over acid, water and belts; it will not go through doors or onto pads.

hopper_fens.name: Swamp Hopper

vehicle.board: You drop into the survey hopper's seat. Thirty beats of fuel left in it - more in the cells round the camp.
vehicle.start: The fans spool up and the hopper lifts off the pad.
vehicle.leave: You pop the canopy and climb down.
vehicle.empty: The fuel gauge hits zero. The fans cough, slow, and stop; the hopper settles. (Enter: climb out)
vehicle.wreck: The hopper's fan pods tear loose. You are thrown out as it goes up.

man: A survey team's X-47B, left at its camp in the fens with a little fuel in it.
It flies over water and slopes until its fuel runs out, then glides down to the nearest firm, dry ground.

bugrat.name: bugrat
man: A scrap of a crawler, the size of a rat, built by the hundred.
One goes down to a kick. They never come one at a time: a pack keeps off and circles until
enough of it is near, then comes at you from every side at once, and each one bites the
harder for the others at you. Kill half and the rest scatter. Stand with your back to a wall.

sweeper.name: gc sweeper
man: The garbage collector's sweep squads: mark, then sweep.
Alone, a weak gun in a white suit. In a squad they bound: half of them move up while the
other half holds and covers them, turn and turn about, and shots from two sides at once
are surer. They mark the doorways they hold with mines - look at the floor.

commando.name: sigkill commando
man: Signal 9: it cannot be caught, blocked or ignored.
A short gun and two grenades. Commandos come in close and together, while longer guns
pin you down; hide behind a corner and the grenade comes round it (three beats: move).
One alone goes down fast.

sentinel.name: kernel sentinel
sentinel.duel_won: The sentinel folds its hand and lets you through.
man: A guard process. It does not attack.
A challenger: face it and press Enter for a card duel.
Shooting it works too, if you have the ammunition.

minisub.name: Bathyscaphe

vehicle.board: You drop through the hatch of the bathyscaphe and dog it shut. F6: dive (and up), Space: torpedoes. It goes where the water goes.
vehicle.leave: You open the hatch and climb out on to the dock.
vehicle.wreck: The hull cracks and the sea comes in. You are spat out in a cloud of bubbles.

man: DS-9 Bathyscaphe: a two-seat survey submarine, yellow, of course.
Walk into it from the dock to climb in; Enter or `out` beside a dock climbs out.
F6 dives and surfaces - under water it passes under bulkheads. Space fires a torpedo.

seamine.name: sea mine
man: A contact mine, anchored, bobbing.
Bursts for 45 at everything next to it. A torpedo sets it off from a safe distance.

emitter.name: MMU emitter
man: The memory management unit's field emitter: it keeps user space out of the kernel.
It does not move and does not fight. Shoot it - through its own field - and the field drops.

glass.name: falling glass
man: A pane from a broken window, falling.
It falls the world's way down, two cells a beat, and cuts what it meets.

counterweight.name: counterweight
man: Tons of iron on a cut cable, down the shaft every few beats.
It fills the shaft: on either wall it hits. Wait for it to pass.

metacron.name: Metacron

attack.wake_text: The Metacron turns its many faces to you. Every crontab in the city is open in front of it:

enraged.text: The Metacron forks everything it has left.

man: METACRON(8) - the scheduler of schedulers, at the top of the spire of collective control.
Every crontab in the city runs through it. Like Cron it schedules fire on the floor, a beat
ahead - read it, step off it - and forks things to keep you busy. Unlike Cron it has nowhere
to go: this is the end of time it promised.

mechwalker.name: mechwalker

vehicle.board: You climb the ladder into the mechwalker's cab and seal it. Its legs take a step for every one you think. Space: the autocannon. It climbs what you cannot; it does not jump.
vehicle.leave: You crack the cab and climb down the leg.
vehicle.wreck: The mechwalker's knees buckle. You are out of the cab before it hits the deck.

man: WK(8) - the mechwalker
A two-legged walking cab for heavy work: a step for every step you take,
a deck plate's worth of weight in each. It climbs a step as high as the plate it stands on and
treads on what is under it. Sealed: it keeps its air.
